Verses.VerseAr: يَسۡـَٔـلُوۡنَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ اَيَّانَ مُرۡسٰٮهَا‌ؕ قُلۡ اِنَّمَا عِلۡمُهَا عِنۡدَ رَبِّىۡ‌ۚ لَا يُجَلِّيۡهَا لِوَقۡتِهَاۤ اِلَّا هُوَۢ ‌ؕؔ ثَقُلَتۡ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ لَا تَاۡتِيۡكُمۡ اِلَّا بَغۡتَةً ‌ؕ يَسۡــَٔلُوۡنَكَ كَاَنَّكَ حَفِىٌّ عَنۡهَاؕ قُلۡ اِنَّمَا عِلۡمُهَا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ وَلٰـكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: These (disbelievers) ask you about the Last Hour: ‘When will it take place?’ Say: ‘Knowledge of it rests with my Lord alone; none but He (Allah) will manifest it at its (appointed) time. It is (seemingly) heavy on (the residents of) the heavens and the earth (due to the horror of its adversities and intensities). It will occur to you all of a sudden (accidentally).’ They ask you (in such a manner) as if you are engaged in its pursuit! Say: ‘Knowledge of it is only with Allah, but most people do not know (this fact).’

Verses.VerseAr: قُل لَّاۤ اَمۡلِكُ لِنَفۡسِىۡ نَفۡعًا وَّلَا ضَرًّا اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ اللّٰهُ‌ؕ وَلَوۡ كُنۡتُ اَعۡلَمُ الۡغَيۡبَ لَاسۡتَكۡثَرۡتُ مِنَ الۡخَيۡرِۖ ‌ۛۚ وَمَا مَسَّنِىَ السُّۤوۡءُ‌ ‌ۛۚ اِنۡ اَنَا اِلَّا نَذِيۡرٌ وَّبَشِيۡرٌ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Also) tell (them): ‘I do not have any control over profit and loss for myself, except (that much) which Allah wills. And (in the same way) if I had the knowledge of the Unseen on my own (without Allah’s bestowal), I would myself have managed abundant good fortune (and victories), and no hardship (and trouble on any occasion) would have touched me. (By virtue of my station as a Messenger) I am only a Warner and Bearer of glad tidings for the believers.’

Words.MeaningEn: and a bearer of od tidings

Verses.VerseAr: هُوَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ مِّنۡ نَّـفۡسٍ وَّاحِدَةٍ وَّجَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا لِيَسۡكُنَ اِلَيۡهَا‌ۚ فَلَمَّا تَغَشّٰٮهَا حَمَلَتۡ حَمۡلاً خَفِيۡفًا فَمَرَّتۡ بِهٖ‌ۚ فَلَمَّاۤ اَثۡقَلَتۡ دَّعَوَا اللّٰهَ رَبَّهُمَا لَٮِٕنۡ اٰتَيۡتَـنَا صٰلِحًا لَّـنَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الشّٰكِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He (Allah) is the One Who has created you from a single soul and made his spouse from that, so that he might find comfort in her. Then when man covers her, she conceives and, bearing a light burden, moves around. Later, when she grows heavy, then both pray to their Lord, Allah: ‘If You give us a healthy child, we shall certainly be among the thankful.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّاۤ اٰتٰٮهُمَا صَالِحًـا جَعَلَا لَهٗ شُرَكَآءَ فِيۡمَاۤ اٰتٰٮهُمَا‌ۚ فَتَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then when He gives them a healthy child, both of them associate partners with Him in respect of that (child). But Allah is Transcendent of all that they ascribe to Him as partners.

Verses.VerseAr: اَيُشۡرِكُوۡنَ مَا لَا يَخۡلُقُ شَيْئًا وَّهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُوۡنَ‌‌ۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do they associate those who cannot create anything and have (themselves) been created as partners with Him?

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ لَهُمۡ نَـصۡرًا وَّلَاۤ اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَنۡصُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Neither do they have power to help these (polytheists)’ nor can they help even themselves.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ تَدۡعُوۡهُمۡ اِلَى الۡهُدٰى لَا يَتَّبِعُوۡكُمۡ‌ؕ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ اَدَعَوۡتُمُوۡهُمۡ اَمۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ صَامِتُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if you call them to (the path of) guidance, they will not follow you. For you it is all the same whether you call them (towards guidance and truth) or you remain silent.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ عِبَادٌ اَمۡثَالُـكُمۡ‌ فَادۡعُوۡهُمۡ فَلۡيَسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لَـكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely those (idols) whom you worship besides Allah are also slaves (of Allah) just like you. So when you call on them, they should answer you if you are true (in making them gods).

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَهُمۡ اَرۡجُلٌ يَّمۡشُوۡنَ بِهَٓا اَمۡ لَهُمۡ اَيۡدٍ يَّبۡطِشُوۡنَ بِهَٓا اَمۡ لَهُمۡ اَعۡيُنٌ يُّبۡصِرُوۡنَ بِهَٓا اَمۡ لَهُمۡ اٰذَانٌ يَّسۡمَعُوۡنَ بِهَا‌ؕ قُلِ ادۡعُوۡا شُرَكَآءَكُمۡ ثُمَّ كِيۡدُوۡنِ فَلَا تُنۡظِرُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do they have feet to walk with or hands to hold with or eyes to see with or ears to hear with? Say: ‘(O disbelievers!) Call your (false) partners (for my destruction). Then execute (your) plot against me and do not give me any respite.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ وَلىِّۦَ اللّٰهُ الَّذِىۡ نَزَّلَ الۡـكِتٰبَ‌ۖ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّى الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed my Helper is Allah Who has revealed the Book and He is the One Who also protects and helps the pious.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ لَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ نَـصۡرَكُمۡ وَلَاۤ اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَنۡصُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the (idols) whom you worship besides Him have no power to help you, nor can they help themselves.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ تَدۡعُوۡهُمۡ اِلَى الۡهُدٰى لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡا‌ؕ وَتَرٰٮهُمۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَيۡكَ وَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if you call them towards guidance, they cannot (even) hear. And you see these (idols; they are sculptured in such a way) as if they were looking at you whereas they do not see (anything).

Verses.VerseAr: خُذِ الۡعَفۡوَ وَاۡمُرۡ بِالۡعُرۡفِ وَاَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ الۡجٰهِلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Esteemed Beloved!) Adopt forbearance, always command piousness, and keep aloof from the ignorant.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِمَّا يَنۡزَغَـنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيۡطٰنِ نَزۡغٌ فَاسۡتَعِذۡ بِاللّٰهِ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ سَمِيۡعٌ عَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O man,) if some evil impulse from Satan provokes you (against these matters), seek refuge with Allah. Undoubtedly, He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

Words.MeaningEn: an evil suggestion comes to you

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا اِذَا مَسَّهُمۡ طٰۤٮِٕفٌ مِّنَ الشَّيۡطٰنِ تَذَكَّرُوۡا فَاِذَا هُمۡ مُّبۡصِرُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely those who have adopted piety, when some temptation from Satan touches them, they retrospect (the do’s and don’ts of Allah and the wickedness and hostility of Satan). So, the eyes (of their insight) open up at the same instant.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِخۡوَانُهُمۡ يَمُدُّوۡنَهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡغَىِّ ثُمَّ لَا يُقۡصِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (as for) the brothers of these satans, they draw them deeper into error (by whispering suspicions) and do not slacken (in promoting mischief and bloodshed).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا لَمۡ تَاۡتِهِمۡ بِاٰيَةٍ قَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا اجۡتَبَيۡتَهَا‌ؕ قُلۡ اِنَّمَاۤ اَتَّبِعُ مَا يُوۡحٰٓى اِلَىَّ مِنۡ رَّبِّىۡ‌ۚ هٰذَا بَصَآٮِٕرُ مِنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ وَهُدًى وَرَحۡمَةٌ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when you do not bring them any Sign (then) they say: ‘Why have you not brought it contriving yourself?’ Say: ‘I just follow that (command) which is revealed to me from my Lord. This (Qur’an) is a (collection) of conclusive Proofs and Guidance and Mercy from your Lord for those who believe.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا قُرِئَ الۡقُرۡاٰنُ فَاسۡتَمِعُوۡا لَهٗ وَاَنۡصِتُوۡا لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when the Qur’an is recited, listen to it attentively and observe silence so that mercy may be bestowed upon you.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاذۡكُر رَّبَّكَ فِىۡ نَفۡسِكَ تَضَرُّعًا وَّخِيۡفَةً وَّدُوۡنَ الۡجَـهۡرِ مِنَ الۡقَوۡلِ بِالۡغُدُوِّ وَالۡاٰصَالِ وَلَا تَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡغٰفِلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And remember your Lord in your heart with humility and tearful submissiveness and fear and repentance, and also by calling in low tones. (Persevere with His remembrance) morning and evening and be not of the neglectful.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهٖ وَيُسَبِّحُوۡنَهٗ وَلَهٗ يَسۡجُدُوۡنَ۩‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed the (angels) who are close in the Presence of your Lord (never) turn away from His worship in arrogance, and glorify Him (all the time) and remain prostrate before Him.
